scope: Original review phases 0–4; closure steps 1–5. Documentation alone never discharges a required criterion.

criteria.criterion: Reproduced trust defects have targeted positive and negative regressions
Repeated analysis is deterministic modulo declared timestamps and run identity
Unresolved semantics cannot report fully evaluated evidence
Complete native CI and declared integration profiles pass
Run, capability, finding, measurement and comparison wire vocabulary has conformance fixtures and native validation
Every blocking rule has prerequisites, applicability, scope, rationale, limitations and positive/negative/unavailable cases
Missing tools, corrupt reports, stale inputs, unsupported syntax and disabled checks never look verified clean
CLI, JSON, SARIF and policy agree on finding identity, evidence and disposition
Required verification failure cannot be suppressed as an ordinary finding
Overlapping engines preserve corroboration, disagreement and exclusion scope
Behavior, unnecessary surface, duplication, escape hatches, locality and leverage have native evidence and limitations
Declared module/dynamic/public boundary support matrix is tested; unsupported scope is explicit
Runtime and comparison evidence validates source, producer, environment, scope and uncertainty
Change review compares compatible finding snapshots, not only changed hunks
Held-out independently reviewed labels demonstrate useful heuristic ranking under thresholds fixed before tuning
criteria.reason: Independent labels and review have not been supplied; agent-authored regression partitions are not independent validation.

criteria.criterion: Anti-gaming examples exercise their target rules, including needed complexity and removal of required behavior
Before/after refactor pairs have executed behavior-preservation evidence and human-reviewed intent
criteria.reason: Human intent review remains required; executable pairs can be prepared without asserting that review occurred.

criteria.criterion: Per-rule accuracy, applicability, abstention, runtime, memory and mutation stability are reported without labeling unlabeled findings
No redundant parsing for the same capability in one unchanged run
Unrequested expensive capabilities remain unevaluated and do not launch tools
Repeated representative cold/warm resource budgets pass and imposed limits appear in completeness evidence
Adapters contain no independent analysis policy; critical JSON is validated at typed boundaries
Analysis permissions distinguish executing tests, builds, macros and other project commands
Publication fault injection proves readers reject mixed generations and retain a usable prior generation
Timeout and cancellation terminate subprocess trees and publish incomplete rather than clean evidence
